user.title: Swiss Avalanche Bulletin (SLF)
user.description: Choose what to set up: the avalanche bulletin for a location, or favourite IMIS measuring stations (snow depth, temperatures, wind) — independent of each other. Add the integration again for more locations or stations.

bulletin.title: Avalanche bulletin
bulletin.description: Sets up the Swiss avalanche bulletin (SLF) for a location. Latitude/longitude default to your Home Assistant home location, but can be changed to any location in/near Switzerland.

imis.title: IMIS measuring stations
imis.description: Select your favourite IMIS measuring stations of the SLF: snow depth, new snow, temperatures and wind, updated every 30 minutes. Any station can be selected — the list is sorted by distance from your home location (❄ snow station, 🌬 wind station), type to search. Favourites can be changed later via the integration options.

reconfigure_bulletin.title: Change location or label
reconfigure_bulletin.description: Change the location or the label of this bulletin entry. The warning region is resolved again for the new coordinates. Entities keep their ids and history; the device name follows the label.

reconfigure_imis.title: Change stations
reconfigure_imis.description: Change the favourite IMIS measuring stations of this entry. The list is sorted by distance (❄ snow station, 🌬 wind station), type to search. Stations that stay selected keep their entities and history; the devices of removed stations are deleted.

abort.imis_unavailable: The IMIS station list could not be fetched. Please try again later.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was updated and the integration reloaded.

error.cannot_connect: Could not determine the SLF warning region for these coordinates.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.station_already_configured: At least one of the selected stations is already a favourite of another entry.

init.title: IMIS measuring stations
init.description: Manage the favourite IMIS measuring stations of this entry. The list is sorted by distance (❄ snow station, 🌬 wind station), type to search.

abort.no_options: This entry has no options: use Reconfigure in the entry's menu to change its location or label.
abort.imis_unavailable: The IMIS station list could not be fetched. Please try again later.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.

error.station_already_configured: At least one of the selected stations is already a favourite of another entry.

danger_level_reached.name: Avalanche danger level reached
danger_level_reached.description: Triggers when the avalanche danger level of a bulletin location rises to the minimum level or above (1 low, 2 moderate, 3 considerable, 4 high, 5 very high). Fires once when the level is reached, not on every change above it.

danger_level_changed.name: Avalanche danger level changed
danger_level_changed.description: Triggers when the avalanche danger level of a bulletin location changes to another level, up or down.

is_danger_level_at_least.name: Avalanche danger level is at least
is_danger_level_at_least.description: Passes while the avalanche danger level of a bulletin location is at the level or above.

is_danger_level_below.name: Avalanche danger level is below
is_danger_level_below.description: Passes while the avalanche danger level of a bulletin location is below the level.
